title: Mlai mid systemdesign monitoring drift
question: What would you build to monitor this model in production and detect if it's degrading?
idealAnswer:
Track input and feature distribution drift over time, comparing live feature distributions to the training distribution, a significant shift signals the model may be seeing data unlike what it learned from

Track prediction distribution over time, e.g. the average predicted risk score, sudden shifts can indicate drift or an upstream data pipeline issue even before ground truth is available

Track actual model performance against ground truth once labels become available, acknowledging that for something like credit risk there's often a delay before outcomes, default or no default, are known

Set up alerting thresholds so a human is notified automatically when drift or performance metrics cross a concerning threshold, rather than relying on someone remembering to check a dashboard

Segment monitoring by important subgroups, e.g. region, loan type, customer segment, since aggregate metrics can look fine while a subgroup silently degrades
